privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial apoapsis radius is 23396.19 km. The Mars gravitational parameter (mu) is 42828.31 km^3/s^2. The simulation must use the Mars Exponential atmosphere model. The final delta-V saved is calculated by comparing the velocity at the final periapsis of the aerobraked orbit to the velocity required at the initial periapsis to reach the same final apoapsis using the Vis-Viva equation: v = sqrt(mu * (2/r - 1/a)).
